page_header: Section A — Very Short Answer Question

steps.label: What it is
steps.why: Several X-ray beams from different angles are combined by a computer into a slice through the body.
common_mistakes: Calling a tomogram the scanner itself.
Saying it is a flat two dimensional X-ray.
steps.memory_tip: A tomogram is a 3-D cross sectional picture from a CAT scan.
steps.margin_note: Say what it is and where it comes from.
lines: A tomogram is a 3-D cross sectional picture
of a part of the body seen on a CAT scan.
A CAT scan is a medical imaging method using

steps.label: What it is used for
steps.why: Because it shows a slice rather than a shadow, structures hidden behind bone become visible.
steps.memory_tip: Clots, tumours, fractures and bone density.
steps.margin_note: Two or three named uses are enough.

lines.text: It locates clots, tumours and fractures

insider_note: A tomogram is the PICTURE, not the machine. Say that it comes from a CAT scan and what it shows.
